value.text: I should verify each driver's entry file defines NewDB and the DB struct, then check where NewDBDriver gets called during startup.

q18.

The `store.Driver` interface is defined in `store/driver.go` and has three concrete implementations, each in its own package under `store/db/`:

- `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` — SQLite driver (`sqlite.DB`, constructed by `NewDB` at line 24)
- `store/db/mysql/mysql.go` — MySQL driver (`mysql.DB`, constructed by `NewDB` at line 20)
- `store/db/postgres/postgres.go` — PostgreSQL driver (`postgres.DB`, constructed by `NewDB` at line 21)

`NewDBDriver` — `store/db/db.go`

It switches on `profile.Driver` (`"sqlite"`, `"mysql"`, `"postgres"`, otherwise erroring with "unknown db driver") and returns the matching `store.Driver`. It is called at startup from `cmd/memos/main.go:57`, and also by the test helpers in `store/test/store.go`.
